title.en: An Act Renaming Barangay Caputatan in the Municipality of Maragondon, Province of Cavite, to Be Know as Barangay San Miguel and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Renaming Barangay Caputatan in the Municipality of Maragondon, Province of Cavite, to Be Know as Barangay San Miguel and for Other Purposes

text.en: The Barangay Caputatan in the Municipality of Maragondon, Province of Cavite, is hereby renamed to Barangay San Miguel.

The Department of Local Government and Community Development, through the Provincial Board of Cavite, and the Municipal Council of Maragondon, Provincial of Cavite, is hereby directed to carry out the purpose of this act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
